US import prices post largest annual gain in more than four years
events.summary: US import prices rose in September, posting their largest year-on-year increase in more than four years, adding to inflation pressure after the hot CPI print.

events.title: MSCI finalizes non-operating company rules that put Strategy and crypto treasury firms at risk of index exclusion
events.summary: MSCI adopted its framework for screening non-operating companies (core operating-asset test plus five financial ratios), which could remove Strategy (MSTR), Metaplanet and similar bitcoin treasury firms from its Global Investable Market Indexes; the affected list is due Nov 11 with changes effective Dec 1. JPMorgan has previously estimated an exclusion could trigger about $2.8 billion of passive MSTR selling.

events.title: Asian AI stocks crash: Kospi plunges about 8% triggering circuit breaker, Nikkei down about 5%
events.summary: After the hot US CPI, Korea's Kospi fell as much as 8.2% to 5,514.96, triggering a 20-minute circuit breaker (its 10th this year), while the Nikkei fell about 5% as AI and chip stocks tumbled amid AI financing worries including CoreWeave debt concerns.

events.title: Deutsche Bank prepares crypto custody launch, targets Asia growth
events.summary: Reuters reports Deutsche Bank is preparing to launch its crypto custody service and is targeting growth in Asia.

events.title: US September CPI comes in hot at about 3.7%; October Fed hike odds jump to about 47%
events.summary: Energy-driven inflation lifted rate-hike bets from about 20%. S&P 500 fell 0.6%, chipmakers led losses; 10-year yield near 5.33%.

events.title: Longest chip selloff since 2006 hands short sellers $32 billion; Nasdaq falls 2%
events.summary: Chip stocks extended their longest losing streak since 2006, giving short sellers about $32 billion in paper gains, while the Nasdaq fell about 2% on Friday as doubts over AI returns deepened; chip-equipment stocks also posted historic losing streaks.

events.title: Bitcoin drops below $81,000 with nearly $1 billion of crypto liquidations; spot ETFs see $261M outflow
events.summary: Bitcoin fell about 3.6% to roughly $80,764 in Asian trading as risk-off spread from Korean and Japanese equities; nearly $1 billion of crypto positions were liquidated and US spot bitcoin ETFs posted $261.46 million of net outflows.

events.title: US September PPI jumps 6.3% y/y, biggest annual gain since 2022
events.summary: US producer prices rose 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y in September (from 5.6% in August), versus about 0.6% and 5.5% expected; energy from the Middle East conflict drove the jump. Core PPI ex food, energy and trade rose 0.5% m/m and 5% y/y.

events.title: Russia to ban direct person-to-person crypto trades from July 2027
events.summary: The Moscow Times reported Russia will ban direct person-to-person cryptocurrency trades from July 2027.

events.title: Dollar retreats from 18-month high as Fed's Bowman and Daly temper hike bets
events.summary: The dollar index slipped to about 102.06 after the hot CPI pushed it to an 18-month high; Bowman and Daly said the Fed can wait for a clearer picture before the Oct 27-28 meeting, and the 10-year yield fell to a three-week low near 5.13%.

events.title: MSCI launches consultation to reclassify Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone market
events.summary: MSCI proposed moving Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone status, saying a Frontier downgrade would not reflect the severity of its market problems; it expects to proceed unless governance clearly improves, with a final decision by end-June 2027 and the index freeze kept in place. Goldman earlier estimated a downgrade could trigger up to $13 billion of equity outflows.

events.title: MSCI freezes Turkey index changes and warns of possible downgrade from Emerging Market status
events.summary: MSCI imposed an interim freeze, effective immediately, on FIF and share-count increases, MSCI Turkey IMI additions and size-segment migrations over concerns about coordinated trading through fund holdings. It may consult on reclassifying Turkey to Frontier or Standalone if there is no progress by June 2027.

events.title: France cost-of-living riots: about 2,400 arrested and nearly 1,000 police injured
events.summary: Interior Minister Nunez said about 2,400 people were arrested and close to 1,000 officers hurt on Oct 17 as more than 550,000 marched; Limoges town hall was torched and 50 Carrefour stores damaged, with fresh clashes in Paris and Marseille on Oct 18.

events.title: Crypto ETFs lose $610.7 million in a week as Ether outflows overtake Bitcoin's
events.summary: US spot crypto ETFs posted about $610.7 million of weekly net outflows, with Ether ETFs losing about $320 million, more than Bitcoin ETFs, per Crypto News and The Defiant; Bitcoin traded below $82,000.

events.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs see $82.4 million net outflow; BlackRock's IBIT accounts for $71.8 million
events.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded about $82.4 million of net outflows on Friday, with $71.8 million leaving BlackRock's IBIT, while Ether ETFs shed about $69.7 million.

events.title: US budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12%
events.summary: The US federal budget deficit for fiscal 2026 rose about 12% to almost $2 trillion, with net interest costs around $1.1 trillion, adding to worries about Treasury supply as 10-year-plus yields sit near 5%.

events.title: French Assembly backs tax on crypto-to-stablecoin swaps by one vote
events.summary: The Defiant reports France's National Assembly backed, by one vote, a measure making swaps of crypto into euro- or dollar-pegged stablecoins taxable from January 2027; the finance committee had earlier approved and then dropped the amendment with the revenue section.

events.title: Crypto funds see $434 million weekly outflows after hot US CPI, CoinShares says
events.summary: Crypto News reports CoinShares data showing $434 million of outflows from digital-asset funds after hotter-than-expected US inflation.

events.title: Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
events.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving application of certain sanctions, restrictions and duties under the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (signed Sept 18, initial measures due Oct 18) and certified to Congress that the waivers serve US national interests; Bloomberg says the waivers cover Russia energy tariffs.

events.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up brief drop below $80,000; US spot Bitcoin ETFs return to net inflows
events.summary: Bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 before buyers stepped in as Asian stocks rebounded (CoinDesk); US spot Bitcoin ETFs returned to small net inflows of about $5.06 million after one day of outflows.
